_why: FR-1 collects non-Python Production file paths while preserving Python-only Test file parsing, Python path order and multiplicity.

mutations.name: P-GUARD: NON-PY TEST TOKENS LEAK INTO PRODUCTION
mutations._mechanism: Remove the production-only guard so non-Python Test file tokens are appended to production.

mutations.name: P-NONPY: NON-PY PRODUCTION PATHS NEVER COLLECTED
mutations._mechanism: Disable collection of non-Python production tokens while leaving Python collection intact.
mutations.find: current["production"].extend(token for token in _NON_PY_PATH_RE.findall(paths.group("value")) if not token.endswith(".py"))  # M:P-NONPY

mutations.name: P-PYFILTER: PYTHON PRODUCTION TOKENS COLLECTED TWICE
mutations._mechanism: Remove the Python exclusion from the second collection pass so Python paths are duplicated.
